consent.body: If you turn this on, members and admins of {gym} and the people in your friends group will see your nickname, division, "on track" score, predicted finish and benchmark times. Your weekly challenge results appear in the standings. They never see your email, heart rate, weight, injuries or notes. You can switch back to Private in Settings at any time; you'll be removed from the leaderboards right away.
consent.bodyNoGym: If you turn this on, the people in your friends group will see your nickname, division, "on track" score, predicted finish and benchmark times. If you link a gym later, its members and admins will see this too. They never see your email, heart rate, weight, injuries or notes. You can switch back to Private at any time.
